name: MCP Tools List
description: mcp_tools_list: Discover the tools offered by an MCP endpoint, including each exact name and inputSchema. With an MCP token, shows that token's custom tool list. Use the same server and token when calling a discovered tool, passing its exact name and matching arguments.

server.description: HTTP(S) MCP server URL. A URL with no path implies /mcp; an explicit path is used as-is; a trailing slash expresses an exact root endpoint

token.description: The bearer to send to the server, such as an MCP token from v/ops/mcp/create-token. Give this or bearerSecret, not both

bearerSecret.description: A secret holding the bearer: s/NAME in your own store, or did:.../s/NAME under a secret/use grant. Used for this call and sent only to the server. Give this or token, not both
